description: This file is a Node.js script written in JavaScript. It serves as a command-line utility for running batch tests on project extensions using Vitest and orchestrates test plan execution, argument parsing, and process management.

methods.name: runVitestBatch
methods.description: Runs a batch of Vitest tests in a child process with specified parameters.
parameters: params: object containing args, config, env, targets
methods.return: Promise that resolves with the process exit code

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Outputs usage instructions for this script.

methods.name: parseExtensionIds
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to extract extension IDs and passthrough arguments.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main async function that processes command-line arguments, determines test plans, and triggers batched test execution.
